website_url.help: The full relative URL to access the document through the website.
website_url.name: website_url

website_absolute_url.help: The full absolute URL to access the document through the website.
website_absolute_url.name: website_absolute_url

activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.
activity_state.name: activity_state

activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.
activity_exception_decoration.name: activity_exception_decoration

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.
activity_exception_icon.name: activity_exception_icon

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.
message_needaction.name: message_needaction

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_error.name: message_has_error

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error
message_has_error_counter.name: message_has_error_counter

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.
message_has_sms_error.name: message_has_sms_error

event_type_id.help: Choose a template to auto-fill tickets, communications, descriptions and other fields.
event_type_id.name: event_type_id

seats_max.help: For each event you can define a maximum registration of seats(number of attendees), above this number the registrations are not accepted. If the event has multiple slots, this maximum number is applied per slot.
seats_max.name: seats_max

is_multi_slots.help: Allow multiple time slots. The communications, the maximum number of attendees and the maximum number of tickets registrations are defined for each time slot instead of the whole event.
is_multi_slots.name: is_multi_slots

event_registrations_started.help: registrations have started if the current datetime is after the earliest starting date of tickets.
event_registrations_started.name: event_registrations_started

event_registrations_open.help:
Registrations are open if:
- the event is not ended or not cancelled
- there are seats available on event
- the tickets are sellable (if ticketing is used)
event_registrations_open.name: event_registrations_open

event_registrations_sold_out.help: The event is sold out if no more seats are available on event. If ticketing is used and all tickets are sold out, the event will be sold out.
event_registrations_sold_out.name: event_registrations_sold_out

start_sale_datetime.help: If ticketing is used, contains the earliest starting sale date of tickets.
start_sale_datetime.name: start_sale_datetime

date_tz.help: Indicates the timezone in which the event dates/times will be displayed on the website.
date_tz.name: date_tz

date_begin.help: When the event is scheduled to take place (expressed in your local timezone on the form view).
date_begin.name: date_begin

event_url.help: Link where the online event will take place.
event_url.name: event_url

lang.help: All the communication emails sent to attendees will be translated in this language.
lang.name: lang

ticket_instructions.help: This information will be printed on your tickets.
ticket_instructions.name: ticket_instructions

website_visibility.help:
Defines the Visibility of the Event on the Website and searches.

            Note that the EventEvent is however always available via its link.
website_visibility.name: website_visibility

website_menu.help: Allows to display and manage event-specific menus on website.
website_menu.name: website_menu

start_today.help: Whether event is going to start today if still not ongoing
start_today.name: start_today

sale_order_lines_ids.name: sale_order_lines_ids
sale_order_lines_ids.string: All sale order lines pointing to this event
